Hello! I'm AURA, your AI-powered medical health operating system. I'm here to assist with symptom analysis, medication guidance, and clinical reasoning, but I always recommend consulting a qualified healthcare professional for any diagnosis or treatment decisions. 

How can I help you today? Do you have health-related questions, symptoms you'd like to discuss, or need guidance on a medical concern? I'm here to support you with evidence-based information and compassionate care.
